children: New Delhi, Nov. 14 -- Lesser known stocks with high dividend yield: Coal India, Indian Oil Corporation, Vedanta, are among top names in the Indian stock market when it comes to high dividend yield. It tells how much income investors can earn relative to investment in a stock.
For investors with keen interest in dividend yield stocks, here's a list of 10 lesser known stocks with up to 16% yield in the financial year 2025-26.
CyberTech Systems, Majestic Auto, Jagran Prakash, IL&FS Investment Managers, Premco Global, Premco Global, and Indo Borax & Chemicals have more than 10% dividend yield for FY26.

CyberTech Systems has announced a total of Rs.24 per equity share of dividend in the financial year 2025-26. With this, its dividend yield stood at 19.6% in one year. The stock closed 3.25% lower at Rs.126.50 per share on BSE on Friday, November 13.

Majestic Auto has paid a total of Rs.68.1 per share dividend in FY26, and its annual dividend yield stood at 16.4% for FY26. The stock closed 1.23% lower at Rs.365.30 per share on BSE with a market capitalisation of Rs.379.82 crore on Friday.

Jagran Prakashan has announced a total of Rs.10 per equity share dividend in the previous financial year 2025-26. Its dividend yield stood at 16.1% for the financial year. The stock closed 0.31% lower at Rs.66.57 per share on BSE on Friday.
The company has announced Rs.1.2 per share payout over the last one year and its dividend yield stood at 15.9%. The stock closed 0.50% higher at Rs.8 per share on NSE on Friday.

The company has paid Rs.44 per equity share dividend in the previous financial year. With this, its annual dividend yield stood at 11.2% in FY26. The company stock closed 4.68% lower at Rs.395 apiece on BSE on Friday.

Annual dividend yield is the total dividend a company pays per share in a year. It is expressed as a percentage of the stock's market price. It matters for investors to understand how much income is generated above the investment made in that stock.
